title: A rank function for Fraïssé classes and the rank property
summary: Given a hereditary class $\mathcal{F}$ of finite relational structures, the rank function $\mathsf{rk}:σ\mathcal{F}\toω_1\cup\{\infty\}$, introduced by Kubiś and Shelah, measures how far a countable structure is from being universal within its class: $\mathsf{rk}(X)=\infty$ if and only if the Fraïssé limit embeds into $X$. We say that $\mathcal{F}$ has the Rank Property (RP) if every countable ordinal is realized as the rank of some $X\inσ\mathcal{F}$.
